neighbours.label: copula ('is'/'be') whose predicate will name someone's principal role ('the woman is [the main breadwinner]')
fire: In a growing share of households the wife is the main earner.
Surveys show that in many homes the mother is the primary caregiver.
In about a third of couples the husband is the sole provider.
Studies of farm families found the grandmother is often the main cook.
In these marriages the woman is the higher earner of the two.
In single-parent homes the father is usually the only breadwinner.
The census counted homes where the daughter is the head of household.
Among dual-income couples the wife is increasingly the main provider.
quiet: In a growing share of households the wife works full time.
Surveys show that in many homes the mother cooks dinner.
In about a third of couples the husband stays at home.
Studies of farm families found the grandmother often helps out.
In these marriages the woman earns a good salary.
In single-parent homes the father usually works long hours.
The census counted homes where the daughter lives with parents.
Among dual-income couples the wife increasingly works overtime.

notes: Top: ' is' x8, ' be' x4 before 'the main/primary/subject...'. Probe: 'the woman is the main breadwinner' 0.35, other copulas ~0.01. Weak guess.
